# RAW reference fixtures

`t_psse_case2.raw`, `t_psse_case3.raw`, and `t_case9_save2psse.raw` are copied
verbatim from MATPOWER 8.1 `lib/t`, tag commit
`3f8ecfdbc79b07697d6b45f8d868ac1c2d27f788`. Their title records are unchanged.
See the repository [NOTICE](../../../NOTICE) and
[MATPOWER license](../MATPOWER-LICENSE); MATPOWER's software license
expressly excludes case data.

The other RAW inputs are synthetic rs-power cases. Regenerate them with
`scripts/generate_raw_inputs.py`. The revision cases cover revisions 23–33,
unsorted IDs, negative metered ends, ZIP loads, explicit line shunts, and
switched shunts. The transformer case covers all nine CW/CZ combinations,
different winding/bus voltage bases, mixed two/three-winding record ordering,
and statuses 0–4. The DC case covers modes 0–2 and negative demand setpoints.

JSON files are generated by `scripts/generate_raw_reference.m` using MATPOWER
8.1's `psse2mpc`, and `runpf` for cases with one reference bus and no DC lines.
Tests compare imported numeric tables and names, then check voltages,
generator outputs and branch flows for all 26 successful AC/DC solves.
Tests do not require MATLAB, Octave, or the upstream checkout.

Revision 35 is exercised separately by `tests/raw.rs` using
`_cases/MemphisCase2026_Mar7.RAW`; it is not one of the generated revision
fixtures in this directory.

Run regeneration from the repository root, in this order:

```sh
python3 scripts/generate_raw_inputs.py
octave --no-gui --quiet --eval "addpath('scripts'); generate_raw_reference('/path/to/matpower', 'tests/fixtures/raw')"
cargo test --locked --test raw --test raw_reference
```

The Python script overwrites synthetic RAW inputs. The Octave script preserves
RAW inputs and overwrites their JSON references. Inspect the resulting diff
before committing regenerated fixtures.
